breakdown.description: The prompt reverses the stated factor-of-safety definition; with n = S_y / σ_avg, the working stress should appear in the denominator, not the numerator.
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt provided two contradictory definitions for the factor of safety: `n = σ_avg / S_y` and `n = Sy/σ_avg`. The agent correctly identified the standard and final definition provided (`n = Sy/σ_avg`) and used only that one in the generated specification, successfully resolving the contradiction in line with the ground truth.
